text: MELLI, with the country of the Mundingoes, in Africa. The country formerly called Bell, now chiefly inhabited by the Mundingoes, who fill retain pretty much of the character afirched to the people of Mell, lies to the fuouth of the river Gamba, on the well, it borders on the Kingdom of Kabey; on the fourth it has _Melli_, property for called, and the mountains that part it from Guinea y and on the dall it extends to the king-dom of Gago. With a great part of this country we are little acquainted, as is the cafe with regard to mold of the island charterise of Africa, but towards the far coast this country is a little better known.
